faq.question: Q1. What is Indian Army TGC 145?
faq.answer: TGC-145 is the Indian Army's Technical Graduate Course scheduled to commence in July 2027 under officer entry.

faq.question: Q2. When will the TGC 145 application process begin?
faq.answer: The online application process will begin on 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for TGC 145?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. When will the TGC 145 course commence?
faq.answer: The course is scheduled to commence in July 2027.

faq.question: Q5. Where can candidates apply?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through the official Join Indian Army website at joinindianarmy.nic.in.
